title: GTA: San Andreas

inputs.label: PC
inputs.how: Type the code during play. There is no console and no Enter key. On the mobile Definitive Edition, including the Netflix version, type the code with a keyboard (an external one on iPhone and iPad).

inputs.label: PlayStation
inputs.how: Enter the combo on the controller during play, without pausing.

inputs.label: Xbox One/Series
inputs.how: Enter the combo on the controller during play, without pausing. This is the Definitive Edition on Xbox One and Series X/S.

inputs.label: Xbox 360
inputs.how: Enter the combo on the controller during play, without pausing. This is the 2014 Xbox 360 release, also when played on Xbox One or Series through backward compatibility. Its bumpers and triggers are the other way round from the Definitive Edition.

inputs.label: Original Xbox
inputs.how: Enter the combo on the controller during play, without pausing. This is the 2005 Xbox release. A few codes from other versions are different or missing here.

inputs.label: Switch
inputs.how: Enter the combo on the controller during play, without pausing. This is the Definitive Edition, the only version on Switch.

warning: Cheats turn off achievements and trophies for the session. Keep a clean save.
